senses.sense_definition: To produce or provide a result, answer, or natural product.

senses.sense_definition: To stop resisting and surrender to someone or something; to give up control.

senses.sense_definition: To allow other vehicles or people to go past before you enter a road or cross a path.

examples.text: Drivers must <w>yield</w> to pedestrians who are crossing the street.
